name: Display glasses with a ready-made microphone strip
summary: As the sensor pod, with a bought four-microphone strip that finds voice direction itself. Less wiring.
notes: Written from Seeed's documents; nobody has built it. The firmware asks the strip's chip for the voice angle over I2C (address 0x2C, DOA_VALUE) and builds cleanly, but has not run on this board. Not yet checked: which end of the strip counts as 0 degrees, whether the chip needs its sound clock running, where best to solder the motion sensor (the board has no plug for it), the size of the main board, and whether a small battery can be fitted. A straight line of microphones cannot tell ahead from behind. The display glasses need an iPhone that sends video over USB-C (iPhone 15 or later, except iPhone Air and 16e).
